decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets are identified within [450,699]: (1) a multi-axis jump at index 490 with large N/E/U excursions and persistent oscillatory behavior without confirmed return; (2) a partial reversal near index 500 with opposing N/E changes but incomplete recovery and ambiguous U behavior. Neither interval shows a clean onset–sustained–return structure on all axes; both lack unambiguous opposing return within allowed context. No confirmed temporary offset intervals meet full criteria.

intervals.observation: N rises from ~2.9 (index 489) to ~5.1 (index 490), E drops sharply from ~-0.9 to ~-2.4, U spikes from ~1.2 to ~3.5; subsequent samples (491–498) show high-amplitude oscillations without return to pre-jump levels; no opposing return observed before index 499.

At index 500, N drops from ~5.1 to ~2.9 and E rebounds from ~-2.4 to ~-1.0, suggesting partial recovery or superposed offset; however, U remains elevated (~3.5→~2.7) and motion continues irregularly; no clear sustained platform or return to original baseline by index 502.
